UnityMeshSimplifier by Mattias Edlund (MIT, see LICENSE.md)
Source: https://github.com/Whinarn/UnityMeshSimplifier @ 53fdb3122645bcd3ad2c258235200dff3dfbaa9b
Only the core simplifier (Runtime/ minus the LOD generator/components) is vendored here, editor-only, for
EnemyMeshDecimator (baking low-poly enemy meshes). Nothing from it ships in a build.
